# Mints the registry files (see register.py). Pinned deliberately: mccode-antlr
# is the consumer of these registries, so a bad release must not be able to
# quietly change what gets minted. 0.30.0 is the first release carrying the
# IR-sidecar filter that keeps generated files out of a registry -- without it a
# mint from a tree someone has parsed in can republish the same kind of phantom
# entry this repository was just cleaned of.
mccode-antlr>=0.30.0
